verses.text: Here’s the list of kings whose land Israel took east of the Jordan, toward sunrise—from the Arnon Valley up to Mount Hermon, including the whole Arabah on the east side: 🗺️
Sihon, king of the Amorites, lived in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer at the edge of the Arnon Valley, the middle of that valley, and half of Gilead, as far as the Jabbok River—the Ammonite border. 👑
He also ruled the eastern Arabah from the Sea of Chinneroth down to the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, toward Beth-jeshimoth, and south below the slopes of Pisgah. 🗺️
Then there was Og, king of Bashan, one of the last Rephaim. He lived at Ashtaroth and Edrei, 👑
and ruled Mount Hermon, Salecah, all Bashan up to the Geshurite and Maacathite borders, and half of Gilead, up to Sihon’s border at Heshbon. 🗺️
Moses, Yahweh’s servant, and Israel struck them down. Moses gave that land as a possession to Reuben’s tribe, Gad’s tribe, and half of Manasseh’s tribe. 📜

Here’s the list of kings Joshua and Israel defeated west of the Jordan, from Baal-gad in Lebanon Valley to Mount Halak on the way up to Seir. Joshua handed the land over to Israel’s tribes according to their family divisions: 🗺️
hill country, lowlands, Arabah, slopes, wilderness, and the South—the lands of Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites. 👥
Jericho’s king: one. Ai’s king beside Bethel: one. 👑
Jerusalem’s king: one. Hebron’s king: one. 👑
Jarmuth’s king: one. Lachish’s king: one. 👑
Eglon’s king: one. Gezer’s king: one. 👑
Debir’s king: one. Geder’s king: one. 👑
Hormah’s king: one. Arad’s king: one. 👑
Libnah’s king: one. Adullam’s king: one. 👑
Makkedah’s king: one. Bethel’s king: one. 👑
Tappuah’s king: one. Hepher’s king: one. 👑
Aphek’s king: one. Lassharon’s king: one. 👑
Madon’s king: one. Hazor’s king: one. 👑
Shimron-meron’s king: one. Achshaph’s king: one. 👑
Taanach’s king: one. Megiddo’s king: one. 👑
Kedesh’s king: one. Jokneam in Carmel’s king: one. 👑
Dor’s king in the heights of Dor: one. Goiim’s king in Gilgal: one. 👑
Tirzah’s king: one. That makes thirty-one kings altogether. 👑
